column1: # Game profile of Cuphead (Switch base game v0). Unity 2017.4.9f1 (IL2CPP), SDK 5.5.0.0, renders with NVN.
# Rebuilt from the rewriter's own build records after the original work folder was lost: the recorded
# patch_nso.py hash (e1d060fc…) matches fork/offset-table-family, and today's upstream rewriter reproduces
# the same PATCH_OFF values (main 0x3650000, sdk 0xc50000, subsdk0 0x700000) and the same 94 sdk gates,
# so the modules this profile builds are the ones the earlier sessions ran.
# Build IDs taken from the rewritten modules' fixups.tsv; only the base game is extracted.
# Load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = the movie module).
# The game reads nvnDeviceGetInteger(API_MAJOR / API_MINOR) and refuses to run otherwise: it requires major == 53
# and minor > 208 (main+0x1683148: cmp w8,#0x35, then cmp w8,#0xd0 with b.gt; both failing paths trap). The host's
# default 55.15 made it trap right after WindowCrop. 53.313 is the SDK 10 value that passes; the exact minimum
# minor this build accepts is not measured yet.
# Unity 2017.4 paces its own logic from the present interval; leave it to the game.
# The NPDM declares a system resource, so the SDK sizes the heap as total − used. The application pool is the
# Switch's own 3285 MB, which makes SetHeapSize ask for 0xC8800000 (pool − 64 MB − 1 MB) and the guest block
# hold it beside a 2 GB alias region. Not yet measured on this title: verify with DM_SVC=1 (the SetHeapSize
# request and the highest MapPhysicalMemory address) before trusting the split.
# The rewritten modules are 0x4C00000 (76 MB), more than the 64 MB default the host reports as used, so the
# game's own "pool − used" heap request (0xC9400000) failed the host's pool check against the module size and
# the heap stayed at 0.03 GB; Unity's allocator then asserted in dlmalloc (main+0x1396E04, svcBreak
# reason 0x80000007). Reported as 77 MB, the game asks for 0xC8700000, which fits the pool with the modules.
# Measured: [mem] "SetHeapSize 0xc9400000 + modules 0x4c00000 > app pool 0xcd500000" at boot.
